answer: A juniper-scented challenge phrase is issued per epoch and must be signed within a short window; duplicates or late replies forfeit the stake. Each agent must burn a jade token into a basalt-anchored registry to register, with the burn amount scaling by epoch demand so fake identities cost real value. Attackers thus pay escalating token costs plus lose stake on each failed sybil attempt, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
